app_tagline: The Sovereign Cold Outreach Engine & Deliverability Infrastructure

surfaces.name: hero
surfaces.guarantee: solid dark background with radial blue-indigo specular highlight and 50% opacity subtle dot matrix grid

entry_surfaces./: split hero — brand positioning + live sending simulator left, interactive deliverability & campaign preview matrix right
entry_surfaces./login: branded split auth — value pillar panel with deliverability stats left, credential login form right
entry_surfaces./signup: branded split auth — quick onboarding banner left, account setup + initial sender setup wizard right
entry_surfaces./dashboard: high-density 4-metric KPI ribbon top, 14-day outreach volume/open/reply trend chart center, recent high-intent inbox replies right
entry_surfaces./campaigns: tactical campaign fleet table with real-time launch status, progress bars, open/click/reply metrics, and one-click launch drawer
entry_surfaces./campaigns/:id: multi-tab operational command: Overview analytics, Leads table with CSV upload parser, Multi-step Sequence Builder with variable insertion, and Sender Rotation & Schedule settings
entry_surfaces./inbox: 3-pane Master Unibox: categorized intent folders left (All, Interested, Meeting Booked, Not Interested, OOO), message thread stream middle, conversational thread viewer with quick reply composer right
entry_surfaces./senders: connected sender inboxes matrix with health gauges, daily quota dials, SMTP/IMAP testing modal, and warm-up ramp tracker
entry_surfaces./analytics: comprehensive performance analytics with date-range filters, step-by-step conversion funnel, and per-campaign comparative ROI matrix

layout_and_grids.app_shell: Two-level layout: persistent sleek sidebar navigation (w-64 on desktop, collapsible to w-18 icon mode or mobile sheet) + top utility bar (workspace selector, notifications, demo seed reset, quick action 'New Campaign') + scrollable viewport area (px-6 py-6 max-w-7xl mx-auto).
layout_and_grids.dashboard_grid: Top grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-4 for metrics; Middle grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 where 8 cols host Recharts outreach performance and 4 cols host the real-time Master Inbox reply stream; Bottom grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 for Active Campaigns roster and Sender Health breakdown.
layout_and_grids.master_inbox_grid: 3-column fixed layout: Left 240px folder/sentiment filter list; Middle 360px thread snippet feed with unread indicators and badge chips; Right flex-1 deep message conversation pane with contact metadata sidebar and inline rich reply composer.
layout_and_grids.campaign_detail_tabs: Tabs: 1. Overview (charts, open/click funnels, quick stats), 2. Leads (CSV drag-and-drop importer, search/filter, lead status tags), 3. Sequence (step-by-step email builder with delay timers, variable pills {first_name}, {company}, {title}, A/Z fallback preview), 4. Settings (Sender mailbox pool rotation, daily send pacing, tracking toggles).

rules: Use specific transitions: 'transition-colors duration-150', 'transition-transform duration-200 ease-out'
Hover lift on interactive cards: 'hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-lg hover:border-slate-700'
Tab transitions: quick cross-fade with 'animate-fadeIn duration-200'
Badge pulsing on 'Active' campaign runs: subtle emerald status indicator 'animate-pulse'
Honor prefers-reduced-motion: disable translate effects with motion-reduce:transform-none

accessibility.contrast_standard: All text tokens exceed WCAG AA 4.5:1 against dark base backgrounds #0B0F17, #111827 and #161F30
accessibility.test_attributes: All buttons, inputs, links, tabs, dialog triggers, and metrics MUST feature data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='create-campaign-button', data-testid='sender-test-connection-button', data-testid='csv-file-input', data-testid='kpi-open-rate')
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full dialogs, popovers, and selects use @base-ui primitives which handle focus traps and escape key dismissal natively

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace index.css theme fonts and colors with Plus Jakarta Sans (headings) + Inter (body) + JetBrains Mono (monospaced metrics/code/tokens).

2. Build the complete suite of cold outreach SaaS pages in frontend/src/pages: Landing (Home.tsx), Login (Login.tsx), Signup (Signup.tsx), Dashboard (Dashboard.tsx), Campaigns (Campaigns.tsx), CampaignDetail (CampaignDetail.tsx), MasterInbox (MasterInbox.tsx), SenderAccounts (SenderAccounts.tsx), Analytics (Analytics.tsx).
3. Add all routes cleanly in frontend/src/App.tsx with persistent navigation when inside the authenticated app shell.
4. Ensure realistic seed data and robust mock/fallback data so all tables, charts, sequences, inbox threads, and sender accounts render rich, actionable UI even when static or offline.

5. Include interactive workflows: Add Sender Account modal with SMTP/IMAP testing simulation, CSV lead import parser with table preview, Email Sequence step adder with {first_name} badge inserters, Campaign status toggle (Active/Paused), Master Inbox reply sender with instant thread update, and 14-day Recharts charts with open/click/reply toggles.
